entities.name: The Guardian
entities.description: Apprentice of Kenan Sahrmal who became Protector of Shandalar and founded five guilds of magic; original name unknown.

entities.name: Kenan Sahrmal
entities.description: Protector of Shandalar who trained the Guardian and Azar.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: The plane protected by Sahrmal and the Guardian.

entities.name: Azar
entities.description: Sahrmal's apprentice whose body was fought over by his soul and Lim-Dûl's.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A necromancer who besieged Ardestan and later returned; his soul was placed in the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl's War
entities.description: War in which Lim-Dûl besieged Ardestan.

entities.name: Wizards' War
entities.description: War in which Lim-Dûl was defeated by the Guardian's schools.

entities.name: Arzakon's War
entities.description: War during which the Guardian was struck down.

entities.name: Guildlords
entities.description: Leaders of the Guardian's five guilds of magic.

entities.name: Arzakon
entities.description: Malicious planeswalker who masqueraded as an advisor and persuaded the Guildlords to strike down the Guardian.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: Item holding Lim-Dûl's soul to keep the Great Barrier intact.

events.summary: Azar went against Sahrmal's counsel to fight Lim-Dûl alone; rescue failed and Sahrmal buried Azar's body.
events.quote: a grieving Sahrmal buried the body in a secret location

events.summary: Sahrmal invested his power in his remaining apprentice, who became the Guardian and Protector of Shandalar.
events.quote: Sahrmal invested the rest of his power into his remaining apprentice.

events.summary: The Guardian established five guilds of magic.
events.quote: The Guardian established five guilds of magic

events.summary: In the Wizards' War Lim-Dûl was defeated and his soul placed in the Chain Veil.
events.quote: The Guardian then place Lim-Dûl's soul in the Chain Veil to keep the Great Barrier intact.

events.summary: Arzakon convinced the Guildlords to strike the Guardian down; his spirit lingered and warned the populace.
events.quote: They did so, but the Guardian's spirit lingered

relations.quote: He was an apprentice to Kenan Sahrmal

relations.note: manipulated Guildlords to strike him down
relations.quote: They did so, but the Guardian's spirit lingered
